title: Linija 8 – Produženje izmene trase u Ulici Bate Brkića

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve od 28.11. do 05. 12. 2026. godine PRODUŽAVA se privremena izmena trasa autobuske linije broj 8 zbog radova u Ulici Bate Brkića u Novom Sadu.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads dated 28.11. until December 5, 2026, the temporary change of bus route number 8 due to works in Bata Brkića Street in Novi Sad is EXTENDED.

sections.text: Autobusi umesto Ulicom Bate Brkića, Bulevarom vojvode Stepe i Bulevarom kneza Miloša saobraćaju pravo Bulevarom Jovana Dučića ka okretnici.

text_translations.en: Instead of Bata Brkića Street, Vojvoda Stepa Boulevard and Knez Miloša Boulevard, buses drive straight along Jovan Dučića Boulevard towards the turnpike.

sections.text: Na izmenjenom delu trase koriste se postojeća stalajišta drugih autobuskih linija.

text_translations.en: Existing stops of other bus lines are used on the changed part of the route.

title_translations.en: Line 8 – Extension of the route change in Bata Brkića Street

title: Linija 12 – Privremena izmena trase u Ulici heroja Pinkija

sections.text: U nedelju, 29. novembra, privremeno će biti izmenjena trasa autobuske linije broj 12 zbog radova na zgradi u Ulici heroja Pinkija 16. Autobusi će saobraćati izmenjenom trasom do završetka radova.

text_translations.en: On Sunday, November 29, the route of bus line number 12 will be temporarily changed due to works on the building at Ulica Heroja Pinki 16. Buses will operate on the changed route until the works are completed.

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Ulice Ive Andrića i Bulevara cara Lazara autobusi će nastavljati pravo na Bulevar patrijaha Pavla, skretati levo u Ulicu Feješ Klare, desno u Ulicu Stanoja Glavaša, desno u Ulicu Senteleki Kornela gde će čeka vreme do narednog polaska.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Iva Andrić Street and Tsar Lazar Boulevard, the buses will continue straight to Patrijaha Pavla Boulevard, turn left into Feješ Klare Street, right into Stanoja Glavaša Street, right into Senteleki Kornela Street, where they will wait until the next departure.

sections.text: Sa polaznog stajališta autobusi će saobraćati redovnom trasom do raskrsnice Ulice Ćirila i Metodija i Ulice Feješ Klare, skretaće se levo u Ulicu Feješ Klare, desno na Bulevar patrijaha Pavla, produžavati pravo na Bulevar cara Lazara i dalje nastavljati pravo redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: From the departure stop, the buses will travel along the regular route to the intersection of Ćirila i Metodija Street and Feješ Klare Street, turn left into Feješ Klare Street, right onto Patrijaha Pavla Boulevard, continue straight onto Tsar Lazar Boulevard and continue straight along the regular route.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE POSTOJEĆA STAJALIŠTA DRUGIH LINIJA.

text_translations.en: EXISTING STOPS OF OTHER LINES WILL BE USED ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE.

title: Linije 1,11A,11B,17,21,22,23,24,30 - Povratak na redovne trase u Kisačkoj ulici

sections.text: Autobusi na linijama 1,11A, 11B,21,22,23,24,30 ponovo saobraćaju redovnom trasom od 25. 11. (od 17 časova) nakon završetka radova u Kisačkoj ulici.

text_translations.en: Buses on lines 1, 11A, 11B, 21, 22, 23, 24, 30 will operate again on the regular route from November 25 (from 5 p.m.) after the completion of the works in Kisačka Street.

title_translations.en: Lines 1,11A,11B,17,21,22,23,24,30 - Return to regular routes in Kisačka street

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, od 25. 11. do 31. 12. 2026. godine privremeno će biti izmenjene trase autobuskih linija broj 12, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 69 i 71vmč zbog izvođenja radova na kolovoznoj konstrukciji u Ulici Maksima Gorkog.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, from November 25 to December 31, 2026, the routes of bus lines number 12, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 69 and 71 will be temporarily changed due to the performance of road construction works in Maksima Gorkog Street.

sections.text: LINIJA 12

text_translations.en: LINE 12

sections.text: Autobusi će iz Uspenske ulice skretati desno u Jevrejsku ulicu, levo na Bulevar oslobođenja, desno na Bulevar cara Lazara i dalje će saobraćati redovnom trasom kretanja.

text_translations.en: Buses will turn right from Uspenska ulica to Jevrejska ulica, left to Bulevar oslobodenja, right to Bulevar Tsara Lazar and will continue to operate on the regular route.

sections.text: Autobusi će na raskrsnici Bulevar oslobođenja/Ulica Maksima Gorkog produžavati pravo Bulevarom oslobođenja, skretati desno u Jevrejsku ulicu, levo u Uspensku ulicu i dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Boulevard of Liberation/Ulica Maksima Gorki, the buses will continue straight along Boulevard of Liberation, turn right into Jevrejska Street, left into Uspenska Street, and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: NA IZMENЈENOM DELU TRASE  KORISTIĆE SE POSTOJEĆA STAJALIŠTA DRUGIH LINIJA, OSIM STAJALIŠTA“BULEVAR OSLOBOĐENЈA-FUTOŠKA“.

text_translations.en: EXISTING STOPS OF OTHER LINES WILL BE USED ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE, EXCEPT THE "BOULEVARD OSLOBOĖENJA-FUTOŠKA" STOP.

sections.text: Autobusi će sa Bulevara oslobođenja skretati levo u Jevrejsku ulicu, desno na Bulevar Mihajla Pupina i dalje nastavljati pravo redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: Buses will turn left from Liberation Boulevard into Jevrejska Street, right onto Mihajla Pupina Boulevard and continue straight along the regular route.

sections.text: (Navedenom trasom na liniji 71vmč saobraćaće se samo na polasku u 21:05).

text_translations.en: (The specified route on line 71 vmč will be operated only on departure at 21:05).

sections.text: Autobusi će sa Bulevara Mihajla Pupina skretati levo u Jevrejsku ulicu, desno na Bulevar oslobođenja i dalje saobraćati redovnom trasom kretanja.

text_translations.en: Buses will turn left from Mihajla Pupina Boulevard into Jevrejska Street, right onto Liberation Boulevard and will continue to travel along the regular route.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE  KORISTIĆE SE POSTOJEĆA STAJALIŠTA DRUGIH LINIJA.

text_translations.en: EXISTING STOPS OF OTHER LINES WILL BE USED ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, from November 21 to December 1, 2026, the routes of bus lines 5, 11A and 11B will be temporarily changed due to works in Hajduk Veljkova street.

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Bulevar oslobođenja/Novosadskog sajma autobusi će produžavati pravo  Bulevarom oslobođenja, skretati levo na Bulevar kralja Petra I,  desno u Rumenačku ulicu i dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom kretanja.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Boulevard of Liberation/Novosad Fair, buses will continue straight along Boulevard of Liberation, turn left onto Boulevard Kralja Petar I, right into Rumenačka Street and continue along the regular route.

text_translations.en: Direction B (Airmen's Village - Center - Temerinski Road)

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Rumenačka/Bulevar kralja Petra I autobusi će skretati levo na Bulevar kralja Petra I, zatim desno na Bulevar oslobođenja i dalje pravo nastavljati redovnom trasom kretanja.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Rumenačka/Bulevar Kralja Petra I, buses will turn left onto Bulevar Kralja Petra I, then right onto Bulevar oslobođenja and continue straight along the regular route.

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Rumenačka/Bulevar kralja Petra I autobusi će skretati levo na Bulevar kralja Petra I, desno na Bulevar oslobođenja, desno u Ulicu Novosadskog sajma, levo u Hajduk Veljkovu ulicu i dalje Ulicom cara Dušana nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Rumenačka/Bulevar Kralja Petra I, buses will turn left onto Bulevar Kralja Petra I, right onto Bulevar oslobođenja, right into Ulica Novosadski sajma, left into Hajduk Veljkova Ulica and continue along the regular route along Ulica Cara Dušana.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE AUTOBUSKO STAJALIŠTE   „BULEVAR KRALJA PETRA I – SAJAM“, ODAKLE ĆE AUTOBUSI SAOBRAĆATI BEZ ZAUSTAVLJANJA DO POVRATKA NA REDOVNU TRASU.

text_translations.en: ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE, THE BUS STOP "KING PETER I BOULEVARD - FAIR" WILL BE USED, FROM WHICH THE BUSES WILL RUN WITHOUT STOPPING UNTIL THE RETURN TO THE REGULAR ROUTE.

sections.text: LINIJA 11B (Železnička stanica - Liman - Bolnica - Železnička stanica)

text_translations.en: LINE 11B (Railway station - Liman - Hospital - Railway station)

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Hajduk Veljkova/Novosadskog sajma autobusi će skrećtati desno u Ulicu Novosadskog sajma, levo na Bulevar oslobođenja, levo na Bulevar kralja Petra I,  desno u Rumenačku ulicu i dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom kretanja.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Hajduk Veljkova/Novosadski sajma, buses will turn right into Novosadski sajma Street, left onto Liberation Boulevard, left onto Kralja Petar I Boulevard, right into Rumenačka Street and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE AUTOBUSKO STAJALIŠTE    „NOVOSADSKOG SAJMA – BAZENI“, ODAKLE ĆE SAOBRAĆATI BEZ ZAUSTAVLJANJA DO POVRATKA NA REDOVNU TRASU.

title: Linije 11A, 11B – Privremena izmena trase u Hajduk Veljkovoj ulici

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, od 12. do 21. novembra privremeno se menjaju trase autobuskih linija broj 11A i 11B zbog radova u Hajduk Veljkovoj ulici.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, the routes of bus lines 11A and 11B will be temporarily changed from November 12 to 21 due to works in Hajduk Veljkova Street.

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Hajduk Veljkova/Novosadskog sajma autobusi će skretati levo u Ulicu Novosadskog sajma, zatim desno na Bulevar oslobođenja, desno u Futošku ulicu do Ulice cara Dušana, gde će skretati levo i dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom kretanja.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Hajduk Veljkova/Novosadski sajma, the buses will turn left into Novosadski sajma Street, then right onto Bulevar oslobodenja, right into Futoška Street to Cara Dušana Street, where they will turn left and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE AUTOBUSKO STAJALIŠTE „NOVOSADSKOG SAJMA – BAZENI“, ODAKLE ĆE AUTOBUSI SAOBRAĆATI BEZ ZAUSTAVLJANJA DO POVRATKA NA REDOVNU TRASU.

text_translations.en: ON THE MODIFIED PART OF THE ROUTE, THE "NOVOSAD FAIR - BAZENI" BUS STOP WILL BE USED, FROM WHICH THE BUSES WILL RUN WITHOUT STOPPING UNTIL THE RETURN TO THE REGULAR ROUTE.

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Cara Dušana/Futoška autobusi će skretati desno u Futošku ulicu, zatim levo na Bulevar oslobođenja, levo u Ulicu Novosadskog sajma,  desno u Hajduk Veljkovu ulicu i dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Cara Dušana/Futoško, buses will turn right into Futoška Street, then left onto Bulevar oslobođenja, left into Novosadski Sajma Street, right into Hajduk Veljkova Street and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE AUTOBUSKO STAJALIŠTE    „FUTOŠKA - CARA DUŠANA“, ODAKLE ĆE AUTOBUSI SAOBRAĆATI BEZ ZAUSTAVLJANJA DO POVRATKA NA REDOVNU TRASU.

text_translations.en: ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE, THE "FUTOŠKA - CARA DUSHANA" BUS STOP WILL BE USED, FROM WHERE THE BUSES WILL RUN WITHOUT STOPPING UNTIL THE RETURN TO THE REGULAR ROUTE.

title_translations.en: Lines 11A, 11B – Temporary route change in Hajduk Veljkova street

title: Linija 8 – Privremena izmena trase na Novom naselju

sections.text: Zbog radova na rekonstrukciji kolovoza u Ulici Bate Brkića, od 9. do 27. novembra privremeno se izmešta trasa autobuske linije broj 8 u oba smera.

text_translations.en: Due to road reconstruction works in Bata Brkića Street, from November 9 to 27, the route of bus line number 8 will be temporarily moved in both directions.

sections.text: Autobusi će umesto Ulicom Bate Brkića, Bulevarom vojvode Stepe i Bulevarom kneza Miloša saobraćati pravo Bulevarom Jovana Dučića ka okretnici.

text_translations.en: Instead of Bata Brkića Street, Vojvoda Stepa Boulevard and Knez Milos Boulevard, the buses will drive straight along Jovan Dučić Boulevard towards the turnpike.

sections.text: Na izmenjenom delu trase koristiće se postojeća stalajišta drugih autobuskih linija.

text_translations.en: Existing stops of other bus lines will be used on the changed part of the route.

title_translations.en: Line 8 – Temporary change of the route in Novi naselje

title: Ukidaju se vanredni polasci do i od Železničke stanice Petrovaradin

sections.text: Nakon otvaranja železničkog stajališta na Rumenačkom putu i rasterećenja Železničke stanice Petrovaradin, raskinut je ugovor između „Srbijavoza“ i JGSP „Novi Sad“ o organizovanju besplatnih vanrednih polazaka autobusa na relaciji Šafarikova ulica – Železnička stanica Petrovaradin.

text_translations.en: After the opening of the railway stop on Rumenački put and the relief of Petrovaradin Railway Station, the contract between "Srbijavoza" and JGSP "Novi Sad" on organizing free emergency bus departures on the route Šafarikova Street - Petrovaradin Railway Station was terminated.

sections.text: Shodno tome, od 12. oktobra ukidaju se vanredni direktni polasci autobusa sa redovnog stajališta „Petrovaradin – Železnička stanica“, u Preradovićevoj ulici, do terminala u Šafarikovoj ulici u centru Novog Sada (oba smera).

text_translations.en: Accordingly, as of October 12, extraordinary direct bus departures from the regular "Petrovaradin - Railway Station" stop in Preradovićeva Street to the terminal in Šafarikova Street in the center of Novi Sad will be canceled (both directions).

sections.text: Putnici i dalje mogu da koriste redovne polaske na linijama 3, 9, 9A, 60, 61, 62 i 63 za dolazak do Železničke stanice Petrovaradin.

text_translations.en: Passengers can still use regular departures on lines 3, 9, 9A, 60, 61, 62 and 63 to get to Petrovaradin Railway Station.

title_translations.en: Extraordinary departures to and from Petrovaradin Railway Station are cancelled

title: Linija 4 produžena do železničkog stajališta Rumenački put

sections.text: Od 7. oktobra  trasa linije 4 produžava se do Rumenačkog puta, čime je građanima omogućena direktna veza javnim prevozom do železničkog stajališta Rumenački put.

text_translations.en: From October 7th, the route of line 4 is extended to Rumenački put, which enables citizens to have a direct connection by public transport to the railway stop Rumenački put.

sections.text: Autobusi na liniji će sa Bulevara oslobođenja nastavljati Bulevarom Jaše Tomića, Rumenačkom ulicom i Rumenačkim putem do železničkog stajališta Rumenački put. Ista trasa koristi se i u suprotnom smeru.

text_translations.en: Buses on the line will continue from the Boulevard of Liberation to the Boulevard of Jaša Tomić, Rumenački street and Rumenački put to the railway stop Rumenački put. The same route is used in the opposite direction.

sections.text: Na produženom delu trase koriste se postojeća stajališta, a uvedeno je i novo stajalište u okviru parking zone železničkog stajališta Rumenački put.

text_translations.en: On the extended part of the route, the existing stops are used, and a new stop was introduced within the parking zone of the Rumenački put railway station.

sections.text: Sa izmenom trase promenjen je i naziv linije, koja sada saobraća pod nazivom LIMAN 4 – CENTAR – Železnička stanica (Rumenački put).

text_translations.en: With the change of the route, the name of the line was also changed, which now runs under the name LIMAN 4 - CENTAR - Railway station (Rumenački put).

sections.text: Produžavanjem linije 4 unapređuje se povezanost nove Železničke stanice sa centralnim gradskim područjem, kao i sa drugim važnim gradskim pravcima. Linija povezuje više značajnih odredišta, među kojima su Futoška pijaca, Bulevar Mihajla Pupina i područje Novosadskog univerziteta.

text_translations.en: The extension of line 4 improves the connection of the new railway station with the central city area, as well as with other important city routes. The line connects several important destinations, including the Futoška market, Mihajla Pupina Boulevard and the area of ​​the University of Novi Sad.

sections.text: Izmena trase doprinosi boljoj dostupnosti javnog prevoza za građane koji koriste železnički prevoz, a dodatno unapređuje prevoznu uslugu za stanovnike Avijatičarskog naselja i mogućnosti putovanja ka Univerzitetu.

text_translations.en: The route change contributes to better availability of public transport for citizens who use rail transport, and additionally improves the transport service for the residents of Avijatičarski settlement and the possibility of traveling to the University.

sections.text: Pored linije 4, do novog železničkog stajališta Rumenački put građani mogu da koriste i linije 5, 14, 41, 42 i 43.

text_translations.en: In addition to line 4, citizens can also use lines 5, 14, 41, 42 and 43 to reach the new railway stop Rumenački put.

title_translations.en: Line 4 extended to the railway stop Rumenački put
